info.description: Email addresses captured by the order popup. Created by the website - read here, do not add by hand.

email.description: The address the visitor signed up with. Validated in the browser and again on the server.

source.description: Which part of the site the sign-up came from, so entries stay traceable if more forms are added later.

submitted_at.description: When the visitor submitted the form. Recorded by the website in the visitor's moment, separate from Strapi's own created-at.
